board.note: Triangular tiling on a hex grid. Each hex cell holds one triangular tile in either up or down orientation. Adjacent cells share one edge; matching numbers must touch at shared edges. Board grows as tiles are placed.

hand.note: Each player's private hand of triangular tiles.

pool.note: Face-down draw pool. Server shuffles at game start and deals initial hands. Players draw from here when they have no legal play.

score.note: Running score for each player. Points equal the sum of edge values on each placed tile, plus bonuses for completing enclosed regions.

tile.note: Triangular tile with three numbered edges (0-5). 56 unique tiles: all sorted combinations (edge_a <= edge_b <= edge_c). Orientation (up/down) is set when placed to fit the triangular tiling pattern.

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Server shuffles the pool and deals 7 tiles to each player's hand.

phases.name: play
phases.note: On each turn: place a tile from hand onto the board (matching edges), or draw from the pool if no legal play exists, or pass if pool is empty and no legal play.

phases.name: score_placement
phases.note: After placement, score the sum of the placed tile's edge values. Then check if any enclosed regions were completed for bonus points.

constraints: tile is in current player hand
tile orientation (up/down) must match cell position in triangular tiling
all edges touching adjacent placed tiles must have matching numbers

edge_matching.definition: When a tile is placed adjacent to existing tiles, each shared edge must have the same number on both sides.

first_play.definition: First tile may be placed freely at origin with no matching constraint.

draw_from_pool.definition: If no legal placement exists, draw one tile from the pool. Turn ends after drawing.

pass.definition: Pass the turn. Only legal when no tile in hand can be legally placed and the pool is empty.

placement_scoring.effect: add tile.edge_a + tile.edge_b + tile.edge_c to current player score

region_bonus.trigger: after tile placement completes an enclosed region
region_bonus.effect: bonus points equal to sum of all edge values on tiles bordering the enclosed region
region_bonus.note: An enclosed region is a group of empty cells completely surrounded by placed tiles. Detecting this requires WASM flood-fill.

tile_rotation.definition: Triangular tiles may be rotated 120 or 240 degrees before placement. This permutes which edge faces which direction but does not change the set of edge values.
